A '''variant''' of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] with chainsaws as hand appendages was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One such droid was present during the [[Battle of Simocadia]], where it used its chainsaws to cut through a wooden door in the Royal Palace. It then attempted to use the saws as the melee weapons against the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] defending the palace, but was cut in half by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] lightsaber.
